svg.title: Сгибание ног на скользящих дисках — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Supine hamstring slider curl, low side three-quarter view. Back of head, shoulders and arms rest on floor; both feet HEELS rest on two separate SMALL FLAT CIRCULAR SLIDING DISCS directly on floor in BOTH panels, toes point upward. Left: legs extended, heels farther from hips, hips raised, body in shallow straight line from shoulders to heels. Right: both knees bend and heels pull the two sliding discs inward toward buttocks along floor; hips remain raised. Separate both feet enough to see both discs clearly. No step, bench, towel, cable, or ball. Show same pair of discs moving along floor, no disc floating. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
